title: Assistant Professor of Finance (f/m/d) – Tenure Track
employer: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
text:
WHU invites applications for the position of
Assistant Professor of Finance (f/m/d)
– Tenure Track
at WHU Campus Vallendar, starting March 1, 2027 or later.
Academic Environment
WHU has more than 50 faculty members in the fields of economics, entrepreneurship and innovation, finance and accounting, management, marketing and sales, and supply chain management. Research at WHU adheres to three research principles: quality, internationality, as well as practical and academic relevance. WHU faculty consistently publish their research in the most prestigious journals. The position is based in the Finance & Accounting Group and will be associated with the newly established Center of Excellence for Entrepreneurial Families.
Job Description
Performing research in the fields of household finance, investments and/or sustainable finance and publishing in leading research journals
Contributing to research activities of the newly established Center of Excellence for Entrepreneurial Families, which focuses on the fields of research mentioned above
Conducting teaching across the various WHU degree programs (in English)
Mentoring theses (Bachelor, Master, MBA)
Performing services to the academic community
Job Qualifications
Ph.D. or equivalent academic qualification in finance or a closely related discipline
Outstanding research record as evidenced by publications in leading academic journals, presentations at excellent conferences, and/or a promising research pipeline
Teaching experience (especially in English)
Outstanding English communication skills
International experience is advantageous
What we offer
An attractive package that includes a competitive salary and research budget
A six-year appointment with the opportunity to obtain tenure, if the WHU requirements for tenure are met (e.g., excellence in research)
Modern campuses with a high-quality infrastructure for research and teaching
A dedicated mentoring program for assistant professors
Opportunities for professional and personal development, including language courses
Integration support for new faculty members
WHU is an equal opportunity employer and thus welcomes applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds. We believe in the benefits of diversity and therefore foster an international, inclusive, and inspiring working environment.
Application Process
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until the position is filled. Please send your application, including cover letter, curriculum vitae, job market paper, full publication list, teaching evaluations, and names of up to three references via Interfolio following this link: https://apply.interfolio.com/193482
For informal inquiries about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Professor Nic Schaub (nic.schaub@whu.edu).
If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Diana Stasch (diana.stasch@whu.edu).
